question: May the existing repair9648 withdraw three explicitly unreleased Sector proposals from the admitted migration-packet namespace without approving their proposed redesign?
answer: >
  Yes, for existing repair9648 from relocation db4256f8adb2729b86b7810d1ef94ae78cff566f,
  with only the README clarification of this ruling and this knowledge record.
  This is conservative documentation de-admission, not Sector reference approval.
